instruments.name: Vibrato Lead
instruments.description: A 25% pulse with a fainter square an octave up and a tracker-style vibrato for singing melodies.

instruments.name: Drawbar Organ
instruments.description: Sine and triangle stops an octave below, at, and above the note, held steady like a tonewheel organ.

instruments.name: Snare
instruments.description: White-noise wires over two short drum tones a bit under an octave apart, 808-style; play it around F#3.
